title: Constraint Enforcement
text: 修改控制动作以满足约束和动作边界，输入 6 路、输出 2 路；按 {Constraint bound} 指定约束边界；{Number of constraints} 指定约束数量、{Number of actions} 指定动作数量、{Use external source} 添加外部约束边界输入端口、{Use external source for upper bound} 添加动作上界输入端口、{Use external source for lower bound} 添加动作下界输入端口、{Sample time} 指定优化采样时间、{Maximum iterations} 指定最大优化迭代次数、{Constraint tolerance} 指定约束违反容差 1e-6、{Optimization status} 添加退出标志输出端口、{Ignore constraints when QP is infeasible} 指定当优化不可行时禁用约束、{Ignore action bounds when QP is infeasible} 指定当优化不可行时禁用动作边界，按实例取值。

ports.name: fx
ports.summary: 约束函数偏移系数 scalar | vector

ports.name: gx
ports.summary: 约束函数线性系数 scalar | vector | matrix

ports.name: umax
ports.summary: 动作信号上界 scalar | vector

ports.name: umin
ports.summary: 动作信号下界 scalar | vector

ports.name: u*
ports.summary: 修改后的控制动作 scalar | vector

params.name: Constraint bound
params.values: 约束边界 0 (default) | finite scalar | vector

params.name: Use external source
params.values: 添加外部约束边界输入端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Use external source for upper bound
params.values: 添加动作上界输入端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Use external source for lower bound
params.values: 添加动作下界输入端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: 优化采样时间 0.1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Maximum iterations
params.values: 最大优化迭代次数 200 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Constraint tolerance
params.values: 约束违反容差 1e-6 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Optimization status
params.values: 添加退出标志输出端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Ignore constraints when QP is infeasible
params.values: 当优化不可行时禁用约束 off (default) | on

params.name: Ignore action bounds when QP is infeasible
params.values: 当优化不可行时禁用动作边界 off (default) | on
